description: A tiny internal knowledge base the agent's search tool looks things up in. Deliberately small and unambiguous so the agent's tool selection and answers are easy to check in class.

entries.text: The standard UK VAT rate is 20%. A reduced rate of 5% applies to some goods such as home energy. Some items are zero-rated.
Full-time staff receive 25 days of annual leave per year, plus 8 UK public holidays.
Business mileage in a personal car is reimbursed at 45p per mile for the first 10,000 miles, then 25p per mile.
Any single expense over £25, or monthly claims over £150, need line-manager approval before the expense is incurred.
Eligible staff may work remotely up to 3 days per week, subject to manager agreement.
Report a lost or stolen company device to the IT service desk within 4 hours of discovering the loss.
